punchline: Newspapers once reported butter made from coal.
thirty_sec: In late 1939 the Associated Press reported the Nazis were close to making butter from coal, on the word of a scientist who had left Germany. The Fischer-Tropsch process was real, but historians call the report overexcited and the method inefficient.
question: Which food headline you read recently claimed more than the text underneath showed?
key_contrast: A real industrial process wrapped in an inflated headline.
